summary: FASE 2 Payment Flow Revamp tested. Backend: 9/10 pytest passed. Frontend: all FASE 2 UI flows verified (bank transfer w/ Pay Now+Pay Later, QRIS w/ paid/cancel/retry, COD).

minor.issue: Cache-Control header set to 'public, max-age=31536000' in code is overridden by Cloudflare proxy to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'. Image is still served correctly. Either accept it as proxy behavior or add Surrogate-Control / explicit cache override.

integration_issues.issue: Form inputs (name/phone/address) lack expected data-testid attrs ('checkout-name-input', 'checkout-phone-input', 'checkout-address-input'). Only payment-related testids present. Submit button uses data-testid='checkout-btn' (review request mentions 'checkout-submit'). Functionality works but test stability is impacted.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add data-testid attrs to checkout form inputs (name/phone/address) for test automation; rename submit btn from 'checkout-btn' to 'checkout-submit' if test spec compliance needed.
OPTIONAL: Address Cache-Control header override by Cloudflare for /api/media/{id} if long-term caching is desired.

Backfill logic for payment_texts in seed_database() merges missing keys without wiping existing user-edited values. Verified working.
